description: This file defines the AbbreviationDictionaryEditorFragment class, which is a UI component for editing abbreviation dictionaries within the app. It includes nested classes for the adapter and custom dictionary implementation, handling UI binding, data loading, and dictionary modifications.

classes.name: AbbreviationDictionaryEditorFragment
classes.description: A fragment for editing abbreviation dictionaries, extending UserDictionaryEditorFragment, managing UI lifecycle, and creating custom adapters and dictionaries.

classes.name: AbbreviationEditorWordsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying and editing abbreviation words, binding data to views, and creating new entries.

classes.name: MyAbbreviationsDictionary
classes.description: Custom implementation of AbbreviationsDictionary that loads and manages abbreviation words, exposing them for editing.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title when the fragment starts.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Disposes of the disposable resources when the fragment is destroyed.

methods.name: createEditableDictionary
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MyAbbreviationsDictionary for a given locale.

methods.name: createAdapterForWords
methods.description: Creates an adapter for displaying the list of loaded words.
